previous_statement: Because delta>0, tau=sqrt(delta)>0 and tau/4>=0, and also 2+4*delta>0. The row negative mass nu_v is a sum of terms max(-P_vj,0), so nu_v>=0. Together with sigma-sigma_g>=0 from the preceding child, both (sigma-sigma_g)*tau/4 and nu_v*(2+4*delta) are nonnegative, and therefore their sum, the right hand side, is nonnegative.
new_statement: For the same notation C=conv W and d_j=dist_1(p_j,C), def-invisible-mass and the root definition of sigma_g give sigma=sum_{d_j>0} max(P_vj,0) and sigma_g=sum_{d_j>tau/4} max(P_vj,0). Since delta>0, tau=sqrt(delta)>0, so {j:d_j>tau/4} is contained in {j:d_j>0}; all max(P_vj,0) terms are nonnegative, hence sigma-sigma_g>=0. Also tau/4>=0, nu_v is a sum of max(-P_vj,0) terms and is therefore nonnegative, and 2+4*delta>0. Thus both summands (sigma-sigma_g)*tau/4 and nu_v*(2+4*delta) are nonnegative, so their sum is nonnegative.
